jobs_results.title: SAP Business Analyst Data Migration -BODS
jobs_results.description:
The SAP Business Analyst - Data Migration analyst is responsible for delivering end-to-end

migration of master and transactional data from legacy systems into SAP S/4HANA. The

role translates business requirements into source-to-target mappings and technical

solutions, develops and executes reusable ETL and data load processes, and coordinates

data cleansing, validation, testing, reconciliation, cutover, and post-load issue resolution

with business, functional, and technical teams. The analyst must ensure that migrated data

is complete, accurate, and available within agreed project timelines, while maintaining clear

technical documentation and supporting knowledge transfer. The role requires at least six

years of relevant SAP S4 HANA data migration experience and strong knowledge of SAP

Data Services, Migration Cockpit, SAP Load methodologies, LSMW, LTMC.

Tasks and Responsibilities

Describe the tasks and responsibilities in more detail. Use bullet points.



 Experience in SAP Data migration implementation for master and transactional data

from legacy ERP systems into SAP S/4 HANA

 Analyze legacy data structures, define source-to-target mappings, assess business

requirements, and create mapping rules for SAP Data Objects

 Collaborate with the business teams to gather requirements, to drive data cleansing

and data enrichment activities

 Develop robust and reusable programs with SAP Data Services (BODS), Migration

Cockpit, LSMW

 Good functional knowledge in any SAP modules like MM, SD, PP, FICO Participate in planning the data migration cycles considering data object

dependencies, ensure adequate test scenarios, and support the creation of

corresponding cutover plans

 Oversee data migration execution, implement performance optimizations, conduct

root cause analysis, perform post-load evaluations, and generate reports

application manuals, and training materials

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst, Digital Products
jobs_results.description:
Description

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world's leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

The Digital & Innovation group at USP is seeking a Business Analyst who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.

How will YOU create impact here at USP

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP's People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Business Analyst Has The Following Responsibilities

Lead large-scale technology programs including scope definition, project planning, prioritization, execution tracking, and successful delivery.Create, maintain, and manage detailed project schedules, resource allocations, dependency maps, and technical documentation.Conduct readiness assessments across people, processes, systems, and technology components to ensure delivery alignment.Develop program baselines, perform gap analyses, drive reviews, and implement updates to ensure strong execution governance.Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies; implement effective mitigation strategies.Collaborate with stakeholders to gather functional and technical requirements, align deliverables, and ensure milestone readiness.Prepare comprehensive project artifacts including dashboards, status reports, timelines, risk registers, and delivery plans.Facilitate cross-functional meetings, document key decisions, capture action items, and drive closure on follow-ups.Monitor project performance, proactively escalate blockers, and ensure timely issue resolution to maintain delivery cadence.Partner with engineering, product, operations, and geographically distributed teams to achieve program objectives.Provide clear and consistent reporting on KPIs, milestones, risks, and deliverables to leadership and stakeholders.Define program scope, develop feature specifications and user stories, and work closely with engineering teams for implementation.

Who is USP Looking For

The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience

3–7 years of experience in Business Analysis, Technical Program Management or Product Management, delivering scalable software services and platform features.Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to design optimal, scalable, and forward-thinking solutions.Demonstrated experience delivering cloud-scale systems and driving deep technical conversations when needed.Lead effective program ceremonies and working sessions, assign and track action items, and ensure project visibility.Drive software engineering and data initiatives with a strong understanding of the technical and business ecosystem.Influence stakeholders across multiple teams and levels to drive alignment and program success.Comfortable operating in ambiguity with strong ownership, adaptability, and decision-making skills.Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Desired Preferences

Experience in scientific nomenclature or hands-on experience in life sciences, chemistry, pharmaceuticals, or related STEM fields; science-related degree preferred.Proven track record of taking ownership and driving technical projects to successful completion.Excellent organizational skills; strong attention to detail and ability to lead by example and display growth mindset.Industry standard certifications such as ITIL, PMP etc. would be a plus

Supervisory Responsibilities

None, this is an individual contributor role.

Benefits

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Job Category Information Technology

Job Type Full-Time

jobs_results.title: Walk-in || Business Analyst : 6- 8 Years
jobs_results.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Business Analyst 6-8 years


Business Analyst play a pivotal role in managing communication and ensuring the smooth execution of projects. Their responsibilities and required skills are similar to those of project coordinators but with a heightened emphasis on communication and stakeholder management. Here are the key skill sets and responsibilities for Project SPOCs:


Key Responsibilities

Communication Management:

Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications between the project team and stakeholders.

Ensure clear and consistent communication channels are maintained.

Relay important information and updates from stakeholders to the project team and vice versa.

Stakeholder Management:

Identify and understand the needs and expectations of all stakeholders.

Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders.

Manage stakeholder expectations and address concerns promptly.

Coordination and Facilitation:

Coordinate project activities and ensure alignment with project objectives.

Facilitate meetings, discussions, and negotiations between the project team and stakeholders.

Ensure that project goals, timelines, and deliverables are clearly communicated and understood by all parties.

Issue and Risk Management:

Identify potential issues and risks that may impact the project.

Communicate risks and issues to stakeholders and ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are in place.

Act as a mediator to resolve conflicts and issues as they arise.

Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain comprehensive and accurate project documentation.

Prepare and distribute regular project status reports to stakeholders.

Ensure that all project communications are documented and easily accessible.


Key Skills

Excellent Communication:

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

Active listening skills to understand stakeholder concerns and requirements.

Interpersonal Skills:

Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders.

Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

Empathy and emotional intelligence to manage stakeholder emotions and expectations.

Organizational Skills:

Excellent time management and prioritization skills.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

Attention to detail to ensure accurate and thorough documentation.

Project Management Knowledge:

Understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices.

Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Asana, Trello, JIRA).

Knowledge of the specific industry and domain of the project.

Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills:

Ability to identify potential problems and develop effective solutions.

Critical thinking skills to analyze situations and make informed decisions.

Risk management skills to proactively identify and mitigate project risks.

Technical Proficiency:

Familiarity with the technical aspects of the project (if applicable).

Ability to understand and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Adaptability and Flexibility:

Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and stakeholder needs.

Willingness to learn new skills and tools as required by the project.

Leadership and Motivation:

Ability to lead and motivate the project team.

Delegation skills to assign tasks appropriately.

Decision-making skills to make timely and effective decisions.


By excelling in these areas, Project SPOCs can ensure effective communication, alignment, and successful delivery of project objectives, thereby playing a crucial role in the overall success of the project.
Years of Experience : 6 - 8 Years
Educational Qualification : B.E, B.Tech, M.Tech, M.C.A, M.Sc


Only for Male Candidates
Interested candidates can apply at [redacted]
